result.brief: 提出 Householder 运动嵌入，用正交变换把运动信号编码进噪声，在保持帧内高斯结构的同时引入跨帧相关性，实现高效可控视频生成。
result.reason: Proposes Householder-reflection noise embedding for motion-controllable video diffusion, preserving Gaussian structure while adding cross-frame correlation; directly a video generation training/representation contribution.
